$comment: The benchmark roster: one narrowly granted agent per framework seam, a delegation pair, a budget-bound agent and one omni agent. render-config.js turns this plus benchmark/tasks/*.json into the stack's config.json. Names are generic on purpose; nothing here mirrors a production deployment.

scribe.expertise: general discussion, note-taking, and remembering the team's decisions

browser.expertise: reading websites and extracting facts from them

lead.expertise: coordinating work and handing it to colleagues

hand.expertise: reading websites and extracting facts from them, on assignment

thrift.expertise: reading websites under a tight budget
